caption: The drawing consists of two outlined views of a rectangular cabinet, rendered in thin, precise black lines on a yellowed, off-white background. The left side features a side view of the cabinet contained within a rectangular box, showing the cabinet’s vertical rectangular profile, a decorative top cornice, and a slightly indented base with small, curved bracket feet. The right side features a front view of the same cabinet within a larger rectangular box, depicting double doors with a central vertical seam, a decorative keyhole or knob on one door, and detailed crown and base molding that match those on the side view. The cabinet feet are shown at each corner, and measurements in inches are annotated around the edges of the front view, marked at the top, sides, and various vertical segments. Both views are labeled in script, “SIDE VIEW” and “FRONT VIEW,” with scale indications beneath each label. The drawing is centered on the page with ample blank space around the composition, and there are faint signs of age, such as small brown specks and a light watermark in the upper left corner.
title: Wardrobe
